title: US DOE Vehicle Technologies Office / Argonne - Impact of Cold Ambient Temperature and Extreme Conditions on Electric Vehicles
notes: Program record dated 2024-09-12. Three MY2019-2020 BEVs on a dynamometer (SAE J1634), cabin at 72 °F: range -41 % at 20 °F, about -50 % at 0 °F (city -59 %, highway -39 %), -14 % at 95 °F. A heat pump cut HVAC power 38 % at 20 °F; at 0 °F the heat-pump car ran mostly on resistive heat. B116 anchors at -18 °C and 35 °C.
